main.description: Builds an ordered feed of per-record views from current indexed records for the registered feed and parameters selected in the request. Most feeds return hydrated views built from records and identities; the experimental MaEarth feed returns merge-metadata views only. Authentication is optional. When supplied, the AT Protocol service-auth issuer is the viewer and may omit params.viewerDid; anonymous requests must provide it.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request or the selected feed's parameters are malformed or semantically invalid.

errors.name: UnsupportedFeed
errors.description: The requested feed identifier is not registered by this service.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is invalid or incompatible with the selected feed.

errors.name: InternalError
errors.description: The service encountered an internal error.

feedId.description: Identifier of the feed algorithm to execute.

params.description: Algorithm-specific parameters. Omit when the selected feed accepts none.

limit.description: Maximum number of feed subjects to return. The selected feed determines the default and may enforce a lower maximum.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous request for this feed.

schema.description: Returns ordered feed entries, each with a feed-specific view, and an optional cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted when no later page is known.

feedItem.description: One record selected for the feed together with its feed-specific view: hydrated content, or merge metadata for the experimental MaEarth feed.

subject.description: AT-URI of the source record represented by this entry.

view.description: View produced by the selected feed. Clients must tolerate unknown variants.
